desc: Ideate approach based on factoring x^3-y^3=(x-y)(x^2+xy+y^2) and bounding d=x-y by d^3<N.
Implement complete Python solution as described above.
Include exact integer square-root helper and avoid floating-point cube-root/square-root errors.
Verify against sample cases and edge cases such as N=1, small N, and large sample.
